title: Disparities in Multilingual LLM-Based Healthcare Q&A

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring cross-lingual disparities in LLM factual alignment, response length, and consistency across English, German, Turkish, Chinese, and Italian by comparing model outputs to language-specific Wikipedia references using the MultiWikiHealthCare dataset and the AlignScore metric.

Analyzing citation patterns and information coverage in Wikipedia across different languages to evaluate whether LLMs privilege English-centric norms and knowledge over locally and culturally relevant healthcare information.
